title: Injectable ROS homeostasis protective hydrogel inhibiting microglial ferroptosis through the Nrf2/Slc7a11/Gpx4 to alleviate neuropathic pain and promote spinal cord injury repair.
authors: Li, Lu; Cao, Yu; Zhang, Xiangsheng; Guo, Jiayi; Lin, Ziqiang; Zhou, Pengyu; Chen, Chuyin; Chen, Jiahao; Liu, Yike; Luo, Danzhi; Chen, Jiurong; Deng, Yingdong; Sun, Peng; Zeng, Zhiwen; Zhou, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究可注射水凝胶通过Nrf2/Slc7a11/Gpx4通路抑制小胶质细胞铁死亡以修复脊髓损伤，虽含分子动力学模拟但核心是药物递送与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) induced neuropathic pain (NP) remains a major clinical challenge due to persistent neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. We developed an injectable methacrylated and thiolated gelatin hydrogel loaded with quercetin (MSQ) to synergistically scavenge reactive oxygen species (ROS) and inhibit microglial ferroptosis for NP alleviation and neural repair. The MSQ hydrogel exhibited rapid photocrosslinking, sustained quercetin release, and robust ROS scavenging via thiol groups and quercetin, maintaining intracellular redox homeostasis. MSQ attenuated LPS-induced ferroptosis in BV2 microglia by upregulating Nrf2 expression, promoting its nuclear translocation, and activating the Slc7a11/Gpx4 pathway, thereby reducing lipid peroxidation and inflammatory cytokine release. Network pharmacology and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed quercetin's high-affinity binding to Nrf2. In a murine SCI model, MSQ implantation significantly reduced lesion area, suppressed microglial ferroptosis, and decreased pro-inflammatory mediators (TNFalpha, IL-1beta, IL-6), while enhancing neuronal survival (Nissl/NeuN(+) cells) and axonal regeneration (MAP2/5-HT(+) expression). Motor functional recovery assays revealed improved BMS scores, gait regularity, and mechanical/thermal pain thresholds in MSQ-treated mice. This study highlights MSQ hydrogel as a multifunctional therapeutic platform that targets ROS homeostasis and microglial ferroptosis via the Nrf2/Slc7a11/Gpx4 axis, offering a promising strategy for post-SCI NP management and neural regeneration.
abstract_zh: 脊髓损伤（SCI）引发的神经病理性疼痛（NP）因持续性神经炎症和氧化应激而仍是重大临床挑战。我们开发了一种负载槲皮素的可注射甲基丙烯酰化及硫醇化明胶水凝胶（MSQ），以协同清除活性氧（ROS）并抑制小胶质细胞铁死亡，从而缓解NP并促进神经修复。MSQ水凝胶表现出快速光交联、槲皮素持续释放，并通过硫醇基团和槲皮素实现强效ROS清除，维持细胞内氧化还原稳态。MSQ通过上调Nrf2表达、促进其核转位并激活Slc7a11/Gpx4通路，减轻了LPS诱导的BV2小胶质细胞铁死亡，从而降低脂质过氧化和炎症细胞因子释放。网络药理学和分子动力学模拟证实了槲皮素与Nrf2的高亲和力结合。在小鼠SCI模型中，MSQ植入显著减小病变面积、抑制小胶质细胞铁死亡并降低促炎介质（TNFalpha、IL-1beta、IL-6），同时增强神经元存活（Nissl/NeuN(+)细胞）和轴突再生（MAP2/5-HT(+)表达）。运动功能恢复检测显示，MSQ处理小鼠的BMS评分、步态规律性及机械/热痛阈值均有所改善。本研究凸显MSQ水凝胶作为一种多功能治疗平台，通过Nrf2/Slc7a11/Gpx4轴靶向ROS稳态和小胶质细胞铁死亡，为SCI后NP管理和神经再生提供了一种有前景的策略。
